newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bata Shoe to offer 120 pct dividend.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bata Shoe to offer 120 pct dividend.

text.p: Bata Shoe Company (Bangladesh) Ltd may offer a 120 percent, or 22 taka, dividend for the year ended December 31, 1996, company officials said on Tuesday.
They said the Bata, which is 70 percent-owned by Northern Investment Company Ltd of Canada, would announce its annual results on June 3.
"We have informed the Dhaka Stock Exchange about our proposed dividend," said one official.
The company issued a 30 percent dividend in 1995.
Brokers said the news pushed the company's share up by 9.48 percent, or 13 taka, to 150 on the DSE on Tuesday.
